title_en: In the Courtroom (7/20): The Copied Design
note_en: Chinese often packs a long description in front of a noun with 的, where English uses a relative clause after it: 抄袭自己产品设计的假货 is literally "copied-own-product-design's fakes," i.e. "knockoffs that copied its product designs." Likewise 生产假货的工厂 "the factory that makes the fakes." When reading, find the noun after 的 first, then read everything before it as "that/which...".
